s: See every client at a glance: their tier, payment status, this week's workouts and when they last trained.
b: See every client at a glance: their tier, payment status, this week's workouts and when they last trained. Open the Clients tab at the bottom of the screen (on a laptop it's in the side menu). Your Clients lists everyone you coach. Each row shows their tier and whether they've paid, how many of this week's workouts are done (for example On Track · 4/4), their current meso and when they last trained. Use Search Clients to find someone by name, and Sort to order the list by Name or by Last Workout. A number next to a name means new messages or items to review, and a missed workout is shown on the row. Tap a name to open that client. The number on the Clients tab counts new coaching requests, and the number on the Messages tab counts unread messages from all your clients. Needs Attention sits above the list, so the clients who need you today are always first. The list is built from what each client shares with you. Workouts sync when the client opens the app, so a row can lag a little if someone trains with no signal. The consistency tag on each row (On Track, Slipping or Needs A Nudge) uses the same rules as the Weekly Consistency card on their page. Why does a client show fewer workouts than they did? Their phone hasn't synced yet. It catches up the next time they open Meso Gym with a connection. Can I see clients from another trainer? Only on a gym plan, where the owner sees every client and each trainer sees only their own.

s: One list of who needs you today: missed workouts, failed payments, health checks, missing check-ins and more.
b: One list of who needs you today: missed workouts, failed payments, health checks, missing check-ins and more. Open the Clients tab. Needs Attention is at the top. Each group shows a count, for example 2 Missed Workouts, 1 Payment Failed, 1 Health Check To Review, 1 No Check-In Last Week, Form Checks or Unread Messages. Tap a group to see which clients are in it. Tap a name to open that client and deal with it, or use the buttons in the group, such as Message or Dismiss. Groups clear on their own once the item is handled, for example when you mark a health check as reviewed. New Personal Bests is there too, so you can congratulate clients as well as chase them. Needs A Nudge and Inactive pick up clients whose consistency has dropped. Needs Attention pulls everything that needs a coach's eye into one place, so you don't have to open every client to find out who is struggling. Missed Workouts opens its own panel (see Missed Workouts), and No Check-In Last Week lists each client with See Check-Ins, Message and Dismiss. Does dismissing something tell the client? No. Dismiss only hides it from your list. How often does it update? Every time you open the Clients tab, using the latest data your clients have synced.

s: Everything about one client on one screen: their week, their meso, notes, health check and tools.
b: Everything about one client on one screen: their week, their meso, notes, health check and tools. Open the Clients tab and tap a client. The top shows their tier and price, where they are in their meso (for example Week 4 of 5 + Deload), this week's workouts, when they last trained and any missed workouts. Use the buttons under it: New Meso, Messages, Video Call, Form Checks, See As Name and Open Name's App. Switch between Overview, Program, Check-Ins and Progress with the tabs. On Overview, scroll down for Weekly Consistency, Latest Badges, their payment, About Name, your private notes (Save Notes) and their Health Check. Your notes under Added By You are private to you. The client never sees them. About Name shows the client's own answers: goals, experience, current split, priority muscles, equipment, days a week and session length. The payment panel shows whether the client is paid, their price and when it renews, with Request Payment, Change Tier and Refund. Remove Client is at the very bottom, away from everyday buttons, so it isn't tapped by mistake. Why is the Health Check empty? Only the client can add health answers, in their own app. Until they do, it says they haven't shared any. What's the difference between See As and Open App? See As is a read-only look at their app. Open Name's App lets you change their plan from their screens and send the changes.

s: See how many planned workouts each client completes every week, so you spot a slipping client early.
b: See how many planned workouts each client completes every week, so you spot a slipping client early. Open a client from the Clients tab. Weekly Consistency is the first card on Overview. It shows Last Week (for example 4/4 = 100%) and This Week So Far. Below that, one bar per week shows the workouts they did against the plan, Monday to Sunday. Missed and skipped workouts are counted separately, so you can tell a planned skip from a missed day. The tag key explains each level: On Track 75%+, Slipping 50–74%, Needs A Nudge Under 50%. Tags update every Sunday. Consistency also feeds Needs Attention: a client who falls behind shows up under Needs A Nudge or Inactive. When a client is slipping because they missed workouts, the card says so in plain words, for example that they missed 3 of their last 4 planned workouts. That gives you something specific to talk about rather than a percentage. Does a skipped workout count against the client? A skip is shown separately from a miss, so you can see the difference. When does This Week So Far reset? Each Monday, as weeks run Monday to Sunday.

s: Open the app exactly as your client sees it, to check their plan, their to-do list and your branding.
b: Open the app exactly as your client sees it, to check their plan, their to-do list and your branding. Open a client from the Clients tab. Tap See As (for example See As Liam). You now see their Train screen, their Things To Do Today and their meso, with your branding, just as they do. Nothing you look at is changed. Tap the banner at the top to go back to your own view. Want to change their plan from here? Use Open Name's App instead (see Open A Client's App). In Demo PT, open Liam (or any client) and tap See As to try it. See As is the quickest way to answer a client's question about what they see, or to check that your logo, colours and welcome look right on a phone. It's read-only on purpose, so you can look around freely without any risk of logging a set or changing their meso. Does the client know I looked? No. Looking doesn't change anything or send anything to them. Can I log a workout for them? No. Logging always stays with the client.

s: Review each client's health check and any joint pain they log during a workout.
b: Review each client's health check and any joint pain they log during a workout. When a client logs joint pain, they appear under Needs Attention and their page shows Needs You at the top. Open the client and tap the pain report to see which exercise, which joint and how bad it was. Swap or change the exercise from their Program if needed, and message them. Tap Mark As Reviewed when you've dealt with it. Scroll to Health Check to read the health information the client shared when they joined. Pain always has its own icon and label, so it never relies on colour alone. Only the client can add or change their health answers, and they can withdraw consent at any time. Pain is graded None, Mild, Moderate or Severe. Moderate keeps next week's weight, reps and sets the same instead of progressing, and Severe drops a set, lowers the weight and offers the client a swap straight away. Your review is the human check on top of that. Is this medical advice? No. Meso Gym records what the client reports. Sharp, swollen or lingering pain is worth getting checked by a professional. Does mild pain show up? Mild pain is noted in the client's History, so a pattern is easy to spot.

s: End coaching with a client and free their place for someone new.
b: End coaching with a client and free their place for someone new. Open the client from the Clients tab. Scroll to the bottom of Overview and tap Remove Client. Read the confirm and tap to confirm. The client keeps their own training history, and their place on your plan is free straight away. A client can also leave you from their own Account tab. If the client pays you monthly or yearly, use Refund › Stop Future Payments, or cancel in Stripe, so they aren't charged again. Removing a client ends the coaching link between you. Their workouts, mesos and body stats belong to them and stay in their account. They lose the Meso Gym Pro access that came with your coaching, and you stop seeing their shared data, chat and check-ins. Can I add them back later? Yes. Send them a new invite code or your join link. Does removing a client refund them? No. Refunds are separate. Use Refund on their payment panel before you remove them.

s: See each missed workout, spot patterns and move a day to tomorrow.
b: See every missed workout in one panel, spot a pattern, and move a session to tomorrow. Open the Clients tab. In Needs Attention, tap Missed Workouts. Each row shows the client, the session and when it was due, for example 2 Days Ago. A pattern line shows when it keeps happening, for example Missed 3 Of Last 4. Use Message to check in, See Their Week to open their week, Move To Tomorrow to reschedule, or Dismiss to clear it. Move To Tomorrow is a one-off. Their meso and its progression don't change. Skipped workouts older than 14 days drop off the list. A workout counts as missed when its day has passed and it wasn't trained or skipped. The panel is one row per missed workout, so a client who missed two sessions shows twice, and the pattern line helps you see whether it's a busy week or a habit to talk about. Does the client see that I dismissed it? No. Dismiss only clears it from your list. What's the difference between missed and skipped? Skipped is the client choosing Skip Session. Missed means the day passed with nothing logged.

s: Chat with each client inside the app: text, photos and replies to their check-ins and form checks.
b: Chat with each client inside the app: text, photos and replies to their check-ins and form checks. Open the Messages tab. Unread conversations show a number. Tap a client to open the conversation. Type your message and tap Send. With the box empty, the microphone records a voice note instead. Use the buttons at the top of the chat for Video Call and Form Checks. Tap the client's photo in the chat header to open their client page. Clients who check in or log pain often send a note with it, so Messages is the quickest way to reply. Message Several Clients at the top of Messages sends one message to many clients, each in their own chat. Each message shows ticks: one when it's sent and two when it's delivered. When the client has read it, their small round photo appears under the latest message they've seen. Community Rules explains what is and isn't allowed in chats. Can clients message each other? No. Each chat is just you and one client. Do clients get a notification? Yes, if they've turned notifications on.

s: Call a client from inside the app for a quick catch-up or a form review.
b: Call a client from inside the app for a quick catch-up or a form review. Open a client, or their chat. Tap Video Call. The client gets a call notification and joins from their phone. Recent calls are listed so you can see when you last spoke. A call the client missed shows under Needs Attention as Missed Calls. The chat shows a line when a call is started, so you both have a record. Video calls run inside Meso Gym, so there's no separate meeting link to send and no phone number to share. They work well for a quick form review: ask the client to prop their phone up and do a warm-up set while you watch, then follow up in Messages with the key points. What does the client need? The Meso Gym app or web app open, with camera and microphone allowed. Can a client call me? Yes. Clients can start a call from their Coach tab too.

s: Clients send a short video of a lift. You watch it and reply with feedback.
b: Clients send a short video of a lift. You watch it and reply with feedback. Open a client and tap Form Checks. New videos are listed first. Tap a video to watch it. Tap Reply To This Form Check and write your feedback. It appears in the client's chat, linked to the video. Videos you haven't watched yet are counted in Needs Attention under Form Checks. Form checks keep technique feedback attached to the lift it's about. Because your reply links back to the video, the client can rewatch it next to your notes before their next session, and you can see the whole history of form checks for that client in one list. How long can a video be? Short clips work best: one or two reps from the side is usually enough. Can I reply with a voice note? Yes. Reply in Messages and record a voice note.

s: Read each client's weekly check-in: scores, answers, body stats and progress photos.
b: Read each client's weekly check-in: scores, answers, body stats and progress photos. Open a client and tap the Check-Ins tab. Each week shows their scores and answers to your check-in questions. Body weight is shown in the unit the client uses (kg or lb). Body stats and progress photos sent with the check-in are shown with it. Reply from Messages to give feedback on the week. Set your own questions in Account › Client Experience › Weekly Check-In Questions. A client who didn't check in last week shows under Needs Attention as No Check-In Last Week. Check-ins are a weekly snapshot of how training and life are going. Reading them next to the Progress tab helps you decide whether to push on, hold, or ease off. Can I change the questions mid-meso? Yes. New questions appear in the client's next check-in; earlier answers stay as they were. Do clients see my reply? Yes, in their chat with you.

s: See a client's strength, weekly sets per muscle and personal bests.
b: See a client's strength, weekly sets per muscle and personal bests. Open a client and tap the Progress tab. Pick an exercise to see its strength over time: estimated 1RM and top-set weight. Weekly sets per muscle show how their volume builds through the meso, planned against completed. Personal bests are highlighted. Body stats and check-in answers are on the same client page, so you can compare training with body weight. New PBs also show under Needs Attention, and you can get a push alert for them (see Coach Alerts). Estimated 1RM lets you compare sets done with different reps. Estimated 1RM is worked out from the weight and reps of the client's best set, so a set of 10 and a set of 6 can be compared fairly. Myorep sets are left out of strength numbers, and only the first, heaviest part of a drop set counts. Weekly sets per muscle shows whether the client is actually doing the volume you planned. Why is a lift missing? Only exercises the client has logged appear in the list. Does it update live? It updates when the client's app syncs, usually when they finish a workout.

s: Send one message to several clients, each in their own chat.
b: Send the same message to several clients at once. Each gets it in their own chat with you. Open the Messages tab and tap Message Several Clients. Tick the clients to send to, or use Select All. Write your message (up to 2,000 characters). Tap Send To and the number of clients, check the message, and confirm. Message Sent confirms it. If any didn't go, you'll see Some Messages Weren't Sent with Try Again. It isn't a group chat: clients can't see who else got it, and replies come back to each private chat. It's ideal for a holiday timetable, a reminder to send check-ins or a quick note of encouragement. Each copy is a normal message in that client's chat, with the usual ticks and Seen photo, so you can follow up one by one. Can I send a photo or voice note to several clients? Message Several Clients sends text. Send photos and voice notes in each chat. Can I undo it? No. Check the message on the confirm step before you send.

s: Hold a short voice message in any chat, up to two minutes.
b: Say it instead of typing it: send a voice note of up to two minutes in any chat. Open a chat. While the message box is empty, the Send button becomes Record A Voice Note. Tap the microphone and allow the microphone the first time. While recording you see a red dot, a timer and level bars. Tap the bin to throw it away. Tap Send Voice Note. It plays back in the chat with a waveform. Voice notes last at least a second and at most 120 seconds. The other person gets a notification saying you sent a voice note. Voice notes work for coaches and clients alike, so a client can talk you through how a set felt and you can reply with coaching cues while you're between sessions. They sit in the chat like any other message, with the same ticks and Seen photo. My note didn't send. Very short taps are ignored: hold on a little longer, since a note needs at least a second. Can I listen before sending? You can see the timer and levels while you record, and bin it if you want to start again.

s: Ticks for sent and delivered, and a photo when it’s been seen.
b: Know when your message has arrived and when it's been read. Send a message in any chat. One tick (✓) means it's sent. Two ticks (✓✓) mean it's been delivered to the other person. When they've read it, their small round photo appears under the latest message they've seen, marked Seen. The photo moves down the chat as they read newer messages, so it always marks how far they've got. Read receipts work both ways: your clients see when you've read their check-in replies and form check notes, and you see when they've read yours. Tap a photo in the chat header to see it larger: clients see your specialisms, and you see the client's goal and up to two focus muscles. Can I turn read receipts off? No. Ticks and Seen are part of every chat. Why is there no photo? They haven't opened the chat since your message arrived.

s: Keep your own meso templates and starter templates ready to customise and assign.
b: Keep your own meso templates and starter templates ready to customise and assign. Open the Programs tab. Save From Your Mesos turns any meso you've built into a reusable template. Tap Save. Starter Templates are ready-made hypertrophy mesos. Tap Customise to change a template's days, exercises or weeks. Tap Assign to give it to a client. A template can be saved as General, or linked to the client it was made for. Templates save you rebuilding the same split for every client. Assigning a template creates a fresh copy for the client, so later edits to one client's meso never change the template or anyone else's plan. Sets and weights still progress from each client's own feedback. Do changes to a template update clients already on it? No. Each client gets their own copy. Can I start from a client's current meso? Yes. Save it from Your Mesos and it becomes a template.

s: Build or assign a new meso for a client. It appears on their Train screen, branded as yours.
b: Build or assign a new meso for a client. It appears on their Train screen, branded as yours. Open a client and tap New Meso. The builder opens with the client's own About You answers already in: training days, session length, experience, equipment, goal and priority muscles, and their current split as a starter split. Start from a template, or build it day by day: pick the days, then the exercises for each day. Change anything you like. Choose how many weeks it runs. A deload week is added at the end. Check it and tap Create. The client sees it as From your business name on their Train screen. Meso Gym is built for hypertrophy: sets and weights progress each week from the client's feedback. Home Gym is read as dumbbells. Switch the equipment in the builder if your client has more. Because the builder starts from what the client told you, you skip the back-and-forth of asking how many days they can train or what equipment they have. The Weekly Sets per Muscle table shows week one for every muscle, and a Volume Is Short bar offers a Fix if a muscle is short of sets. What if the client hasn't filled in About You? The builder opens with the usual defaults and you choose everything yourself. Can I change the meso after sending it? Yes. See Editing A Client's Program, or Open A Client's App.

s: Change exercises, sets or days in a client's current meso, or answer their change requests.
b: Change exercises, sets or days in a client's current meso, or answer their change requests. Open a client and tap the Program tab. Tap a day to see its exercises. Swap an exercise, add one or remove one. Each change asks Change This Day Only or Change Every Week Of This Meso. Changes wait in a list until you tap Send, so you can make several and send them together. Set Weight and notes are sent straight away. When a client asks for a change (Request Change), it shows here to accept or decline. Workouts the client has already logged never change. You can't remove the only exercise on a day. This Day Only changes one workout, for example swapping squats for leg press because the rack is busy that week. Every Week changes that day for the rest of the meso. On the client's side, upcoming days show small tags such as Swapped By Coach, Added By Coach, Removed By Coach or Coach Set, so they know what changed and why. What happens to a coached client's own swaps? A swap for today applies straight away and you're told. If they ask for the rest of the meso, it waits for you to accept or decline. Is there a quicker way to edit? Yes. Open A Client's App lets you edit from their own screens.

s: Step into a client's Train, Plan and Progress screens and edit their plan.
b: Step into your client's own Train, Plan and Progress screens, and change their plan from there. Open a client and tap Open Name's App in the row of buttons. A banner shows you're in their view. Use the Train, Plan and Progress tabs, just as they see them. Swap, add or remove an exercise. Each change asks Change This Day Only or Change Every Week Of This Meso. Hold and drag a session onto another day, or use the session menu, to move it. Changes wait in a bar (for example 2 Changes Waiting To Send). Tap Send To Name. Back To Coach takes you out. Logging stays with your client: you can't tick their sets. A day they've already trained this week shows a note that changes start from their next one. It shows what your client's app shares, so it fills in once they have a meso running with Share With My Trainer on, and it updates when they open Meso Gym. Your changes are the same ones Edit Their Meso makes, so they appear in both places. Their phone applies them with its own rules: finished workouts and logged sets never change. How is this different from See As Client? See As Client is a read-only preview. Open Name's App lets you change the plan. Nothing shows yet. Your client needs a running meso with sharing on. It fills in after they open the app.

t: This Day Only Or Every Week
s: Choose whether a change is for one day or every week of the meso.
b: Every change you make to a client's meso can be for one day only, or for every week of it. Open a client and tap Edit Their Meso, or use Open Name's App. Swap, add or remove an exercise, or move a session to another day. Choose Change This Day Only or Change Every Week Of This Meso. Changes wait until you tap Send. A weight you set and notes are sent straight away. Your client's upcoming days show tags such as Coach Set: 66 kg × 15, Swapped By Coach, Added By Coach and Removed By Coach. When a client's own swap is approved, it shows Your Swap · Approved. This Day Only suits a one-off, such as a busy gym or a sore joint. Every Week changes that day for the rest of the meso, so its muscle's weekly sets change too. Either way, workouts your client has already finished never change, and their app keeps progressing from what they log. Can a client make changes too? Yes, for today. For the rest of the meso, their app sends you a request. Does removing an exercise every week lower their volume? Yes. That muscle gets those sets fewer each week; other exercises keep their plan.

s: See your trainer plan and how many client places you have left.
b: See your trainer plan and how many client places you have left. Open the Account tab. Your Plan, under Your Coaching, shows your plan and places used, for example Meso Gym PT Pro · 6 Of 9 Places Used. Pending invites count towards your places until they're used or cancelled. When you need more places, tap Edit and move to a bigger plan. PT Starter is you plus 4 clients, Pro Trainer you plus 9 and Studio you plus 19. Small Gym is for up to 100 members, Large Gym for one gym with over 100, and Corporate for several locations. Every PT and Gym plan includes Share A Demo. When every place is used, Invite Client is greyed out and the Clients tab says All Seats Used. Removing a client, or cancelling an invite that hasn't been used, frees a place straight away. Each plan includes Meso Gym Pro for you and every client you coach. Does an unused invite code hold a place? Yes, until it's used, cancelled or expires. Where are the prices? On the Plans page: Large Gym is £260 a month or £1,560 a year, Small Gym £180 a month or £1,080 a year.

s: Send a possible client a 1-hour demo of your app, in your branding. No account needed and nothing is saved.
b: Send a possible client a 1-hour demo of your app, in your branding. No account needed and nothing is saved. Open the Clients tab and scroll to Share A Demo. Tap Make My Demo Link. Tap Share, Copy Link or Email to send it. Email sends it in your branding. They see a sample client coached by you: your logo, colours, programs, prices and welcome message. Pay is switched off. When the hour ends they see Like It? Join with your name and a button to your join link. Write a short Welcome Message: it is the first thing they read. Opens and See Visits show how many people tried it and which screens they looked at. Turn Link Off stops the link working. Make New Link replaces it, and the old one stops working. Included in every PT and Gym plan. A demo lets someone feel what being coached by you is like before they commit. Studio and Gym plans share a gym client demo; PT plans share the PT client demo. Does the person need to sign up? No. The demo runs in their browser and nothing they do is saved. Can they pay from the demo? No. Payments are switched off in demos.

s: Invite a client with a code. They enter it in the app and join you straight away.
b: Invite a client with a code. They enter it in the app and join you straight away. Open the Clients tab and tap Invite Client. Pick the tier the invite is for (for example Full Coaching). Share the code or link, or tap Email This Invite to send it for you. The client signs in, enters the code in Account › My Coach and appears in Your Clients. Manage Invites shows codes you've sent and lets you cancel one. Codes work once and expire after 7 days. For one link you can post anywhere, use Your Join Link instead. Invite pages and emails carry your branding, not Meso Gym's, so a new client meets your business first. A pending invite holds a place on your plan until it's used, cancelled or expires. The code says it has expired. Send a new invite. Codes last 7 days. Can a client already on Meso Gym use a code? Yes. They keep their own training history and join you with it.

s: Lifters who find you in Find A Coach can ask you to coach them.
b: Lifters who find you in Find A Coach can ask you to coach them. Open the Clients tab. A number on the tab means new requests, and Needs Attention shows a New Requests pill. Scroll to Coaching Requests. Each request shows the lifter's name and a short message. Tap Invite to send them an invite for one of your tiers, or Decline. Once they accept the invite, they appear in Your Clients. Your Find A Coach listing is set up under Account › Get Found. Coaching requests are how your Find A Coach listing turns into clients. Replying quickly matters: a lifter looking for a coach often messages several at once. Read their message, check that what they want fits your coaching, and invite them on the tier that suits. Where do lifters find me? In Find A Coach, through your listing under Account › Get Found. Do requests use up places? Not until you send an invite.

s: Set your coaching tiers and prices, for example Programme Only, Full Coaching and Premium.
b: Set your coaching tiers and prices, for example Programme Only, Full Coaching and Premium. Open the Money tab. Under What Clients Pay, tap Edit next to Your Prices. Each tier has a name, a length (for example 1 Month) and a price in £. Tap + Add Price to add a tier, or Remove to take one away. Tap Save Prices. Changing a price applies to new invites and new payments only. Clients already paying keep their price. Amounts show in whole pounds, for example £50, unless you set pence. Tiers let you sell different levels of coaching from the same app. Each invite is for one tier, and Change Tier on a client's page moves an existing client to another. Your Coaching Terms sit just below your prices: clients agree to them before they pay. Do existing clients see a new price? No. Clients already paying keep their price until you use Change Tier. Which currency is used? Your prices are in pounds (£).

s: Take client payments by card through your own Stripe account. Money goes straight to you.
b: Take client payments by card through your own Stripe account. Money goes straight to you. Open the Money tab. Under Your Stripe, tap Connect Stripe and follow Stripe's steps to set up your account. Once connected, the status shows Connected and Ready To Take Payments. Tap Manage In Stripe or View Payouts to see your money in Stripe. Add Your Coaching Terms so clients agree to them before paying. Meso Gym never touches your coaching money. Clients pay straight into your own Stripe account, and Stripe pays out to your bank on your payout schedule. Because payments run through your own Stripe account, you see, refund and cancel them in your own Stripe Dashboard as well as in Meso Gym. Receipts for coaching payments come from your Stripe account, not from Meso Gym. Do I need a Stripe account already? No. Connect Stripe walks you through making one. Who pays the card fees? Stripe's standard fees are taken from each payment, as set by Stripe.

s: See who has paid, ask for a payment and change a client's tier.
b: See who has paid, ask for a payment and change a client's tier. Open the Money tab. Client Payments shows Paid Up or Payment Due for each client. Open a client and tap Request Payment. They get a payment card in their chat and a notification. Tap Change Tier to move a client to a different price. You're told what happens and when. A failed payment shows under Needs Attention. The client's payment panel shows their price and when it renews, for example Paid · £100 Per Month · Renews 2 Dec 2026. Payment status comes straight from Stripe, so Paid Up means Stripe has taken the money. A tier change waits for the client where it needs their agreement, and their payment history lists every payment and refund. A client says they paid but shows Payment Due. Give it a moment: the status changes once Stripe confirms the payment. Where else can I see payments? In your own Stripe Dashboard: tap Manage In Stripe on the Money tab.

s: Refund a client's current payment through Stripe.
b: Refund a client's payment in full or in part, and choose what happens to their coaching. Open the client from the Clients tab. In their payment panel, tap Refund. It shows Paid, Refunded So Far and what's left. Choose Full Refund (or Refund The Rest), or Part Refund and type an amount up to what's left. Pick what happens to their coaching: Keep Coaching (ticked first), Keep Access Until The Paid Period Ends, or End Coaching Now. On a monthly or yearly plan, tick Stop Future Payments to cancel their plan at Stripe. Then tap Refund and confirm. The reason is optional and private to you unless you tick Include The Reason In Name's Email. Refunds go back to the client's card from your Stripe account. Banks usually take 5–10 days. The client gets an email from you, in your branding, with the amount and what happens to their coaching. You see Refund Sent, and their status changes to Refunded or Partly Refunded once Stripe confirms it. Their payment history lists every refund with its date, amount, access choice and reason. Does a refund end coaching? Only if you pick End Coaching Now. Keep Coaching is ticked first. Can I refund twice? Yes, part refunds can be repeated until the whole payment is refunded.

s: One link for your bio, website or QR code that never expires.
b: One link for your bio, website or a QR code. It never expires, and every client who opens it gets their own place. Open the Clients tab and tap Invite Client. Your Join Link is at the top. Tap Copy Link or Share. Choose a Default Tier, or leave it on Client Picks. Opened By shows how many people have opened it. Use Turn Off to pause it, or Replace Link to make a new one. Replacing the link stops the old one straight away. Clients who already joined stay. Invite codes still work alongside your join link. People who open the link see a Join page with your name, then go through your coaching agreement, choose a tier (or get your Default Tier) and pay. A Default Tier applies in the phone app; on the web a client can still pick any of your prices. While the link is off, nobody new can join with it. Does a new client use one of my places? Yes. Each client who joins takes a place on your plan. Can I have more than one link? You have one join link. Use invite codes for one-off invites.

s: Put your logo, business name and colours in every client's app.
b: Put your logo, business name and colours in every client's app. Open the Account tab. Under Your Profile, tap Edit next to Your Brand. Add your business name and upload your logo. Crop it to fit. Pick your brand colour and theme. Save. Your clients see your name and logo at the top of their app, and their mesos show From your business name. PNG logos can have a see-through background. For a JPEG logo, the plain background is removed for you. Add a Coach's Photo too: it's shown on My Coach and in chat. Your brand also appears on invite pages, invite emails, refund emails and your shared demo, so clients meet your business first. A long business name wraps neatly next to your logo on small phones. Where else does my brand appear? On your invite pages and emails, refund emails and your shared demo. Do clients have to download a different app? No. They use Meso Gym, shown with your brand.

s: Set up your coach profile and get found by lifters looking for a coach.
b: Set up your coach profile and get found by lifters looking for a coach. Open the Account tab. Under Your Profile, add your Coach's Photo, and under Contact add WhatsApp if you want clients to reach you there. Under Get Found, tap Edit next to Find A Coach Listing. Pick your specialities and who you coach, write a short bio, then turn your listing on. When a client opens your photo in chat, they see your specialisms under your name. Find A Coach lets lifters already using Meso Gym look for a coach who fits them. A clear photo, a short bio and two or three specialities make your listing easy to choose. Requests arrive in Coaching Requests on the Clients tab. Keep your listing short and specific: who you coach, what results you focus on and how you work. A clear photo and a sentence about your experience help people pick the right coach. Can I hide my listing? Yes. Turn it off at any time; your existing clients aren't affected. Is WhatsApp required? No. It's optional.

s: Choose the questions your clients answer in their weekly check-in.
b: Choose the questions your clients answer in their weekly check-in. Open the Account tab. Under Client Experience, tap Edit next to Weekly Check-In Questions. Add, edit or remove questions. Each can be a 1 to 5 score or a written answer. Save. Clients see your questions in their next check-in. Body Weight is asked in the client's own unit, kg or lb, and shown to you in that unit. Keep it short: three or four questions get better answers than ten. The default set covers body weight, wins this week and anything your coach should know. Meso Gym is a hypertrophy app, so lifestyle questions such as sleep and stress aren't asked by default; add your own if you want them. Do old check-ins change when I edit questions? No. Past answers are kept as they were. When are check-ins due? Once a week. It shows on the client's Things To Do Today.

s: Your trainer plan includes Meso Gym Pro for your own training too.
b: Your trainer plan includes Meso Gym Pro for your own training too. Open the Train tab to see your own meso. Tap Start Workout to train, just like a client. Use Plan and Progress for your own mesos and strength, and Settings for your units and timer. Tap the Clients tab to go straight back to coaching. Gym owners and trainers find their own training under Settings › My Own Training. Training in the same app your clients use is the best way to know it inside out. Your own training is kept separate from your coaching: clients never see your workouts, and your training history stays yours if your plan changes. Training in the same app as your clients also means you know every screen they see, which makes it far easier to answer questions about logging, feedback or check-ins. Do I need a second account? No. One account does both. Does my training count as a client place? No. Plans are you plus your clients.

s: Choose in-app and push alerts for messages, payments and new PBs.
b: Choose which alerts you get, in the app and as push notifications. Open the Account tab. Under Notifications, tap Your Alerts. Messages covers new chat messages. Payments covers paid, failed and refunded payments. New PBs covers your clients' personal bests. Each row has an In App and a Push switch. Changes save as soon as you tap. Every alert is on to start with. A New PB push goes out once per lift per meso week, for a workout in the last two days. Alerts mean you hear about a failed payment or a big lift without opening every client. PB alerts are limited so a client who beats the same lift in several sets doesn't fill your phone. The first time you turn on push, Meso Gym explains why before your phone asks. I'm not getting push notifications. Check Push is on here, then check notifications for Meso Gym in your phone's settings. Do clients see my alert settings? No. They're just for you.

s: A one-line tip on each screen the first time, and Show Tips Again.
b: A one-line tip the first time you open each screen, so you know what it's for. Open a coach screen for the first time. A tip appears near the top, for example Tap a client to open their page. Tap Got It to hide it. Each tip shows once per screen on that device. To see them all again, open Account and tap Show Tips Again. Examples: Your prices and payments. on Money, and Your plan, brand and sign-in. on Account. In the demo, tips reset each time so you can see them. Tips are short on purpose: one line, then out of your way. Because they're remembered on each device, a new phone or laptop shows them once more. If you're training a colleague, Show Tips Again is a quick way to walk them round the app. Do clients see coach tips? No. Coach tips are only on coach screens. Will tips come back by themselves? Only on a new device, or after Show Tips Again.

s: For a gym with a team of trainers: every member on Meso Gym Pro, in your gym’s branding.
b: For a gym with a team of trainers: every member on Meso Gym Pro, in your gym's branding. Pick a plan on the Plans page: Small Gym (up to 100 members) is £180 a month or £1,080 a year, and Large Gym (one location, over 100 members) is £260 a month or £1,560 a year. For several locations, ask about Corporate. Add your gym's logo and colours in Settings › Your Brand. Every trainer and every client sees them. Invite your trainers from People › Trainers. Each joins with their own Meso Gym account. Assign each client to a trainer. Trainers see only their own clients; you see everyone. Connect your gym's Stripe account in Money: client payments go to the gym, whichever trainer coaches them. Gym plans include 8 trainers. Extra trainers are £15 a month each. Studio also has a team: up to 3 trainers and 19 clients. Try Demo Gym to see Clyde Strength Gym: 4 trainers and 16 clients. As the owner you land on Overview: key numbers and Weekly Consistency for the whole gym. People has Clients, Trainers and Invites. Money holds your prices, Client Payments and the trainer prices you approve. Settings is one place for your plan, brand, sign-in and data. Group Wins celebrates new PBs and finished mesos across the gym. Can a trainer belong to two gyms? No. A trainer belongs to one gym at a time and can leave with Leave Gym. What does Corporate add? Several locations, each with its own checks, and views across every verified location.

s: See every trainer, their clients and who needs attention, and move a client to another trainer.
b: See every trainer, their clients and who needs attention, and move a client to another trainer. Open Demo Gym and go to People. Trainers lists everyone in your gym, with their clients and how many need attention. Tap a trainer to see their clients. Tap a client to open them. Under Who Coaches Each Client, pick a trainer for any client. Their history, chat and check-ins move with them, and they get a note in their chat. Needs Attention covers the whole gym, so nothing is missed when a trainer is off. Each trainer sees only their own clients. This is checked on our servers, not just hidden on screen. As the owner you can read the messages your trainers send. Make Manager gives a trusted trainer the Manager role on Small Gym and up. On Small Gym and up you can filter the client list by trainer and move several clients at once. When a trainer leaves, a handover moves their clients to another trainer so nobody is left without a coach. On Large Gym and up, Overview adds trainer stats, such as revenue and reply times by trainer. What can a Manager do? Managers see Clients and Trainers to help run the team. Payment actions stay with the owner and managers. Does the client choose their trainer? No. The owner, or a manager, assigns them.

s: Add a trainer to your gym with a private invite link, and remove them when they leave.
b: Add a trainer to your gym with a private invite link, and remove them when they leave. Open People › Trainers and find the Team card. It shows how many places are left, for example 5 Places Left On Your Gym Plan. Tap Invite › A Trainer. You get a link that works once and lasts 7 days. Share, copy or email the link to your trainer. They open it, sign in with their own Meso Gym account and join your gym. To remove a trainer, tap Remove Trainer on the Team card. Move their clients to another trainer first, or use the handover. A trainer can belong to one gym at a time. To work for another gym they leave yours first (Leave Gym). Cancel an invite you no longer need from Invites. Studio includes up to 3 trainers and Gym plans 8. Extra trainers are £15 a month each. An invite counts towards your trainer places until it's used or cancelled. When every place is used, the Team card says so and you can remove a trainer or cancel an invite to make room. A trainer who opens a client invite by mistake is told clearly to use the trainer link instead. The invite link has expired. Make a new one. Trainer links last 7 days. Do trainers pay for Meso Gym? No. They get Meso Gym Pro through your gym's plan.

s: Choose which trainer coaches each client, and move clients between trainers.
b: Choose which trainer coaches each client, and move clients between trainers. Open People › Clients. Who Coaches Each Client lists every client with a Trainer menu. Pick a trainer for any client. Or open a client and use Coached By. On Small Gym and up, filter by trainer and tick several clients to move them together. The client gets a short note in their chat saying who their coach is now. Unassigned clients stay with you, the owner, until you assign them. Moving a client keeps their mesos, history, chat and check-ins. When a trainer leaves, the handover moves all their clients in one go. Assigning decides who coaches the client day to day: the trainer sees them in their own Clients list and can message them, build mesos and review check-ins. The client sees Your Trainer in their app. Payments still go to the gym's Stripe account, whoever coaches them. Can a client have two trainers? No. Each client has one trainer at a time. Does the client need to do anything? No. The change is instant; they just get a note in their chat.

t: Working As A Trainer In A Gym
s: What a trainer sees after joining a gym: their own clients, with the gym’s brand and payments.
b: What a trainer sees after joining a gym: their own clients, with the gym's brand and payments. Open the invite link from your gym and sign in with your own Meso Gym account. You get Meso Gym Pro through the gym's plan, so you can build mesos for your clients. Your Clients shows only the clients the gym assigned to you. Message them, build mesos, review check-ins and track progress as usual. Prices, payments and the gym's brand are managed by the owner. To stop working for the gym, tap Leave Gym next to your gym's name under the Clients heading. Your clients go back to the gym owner, and your own account and workouts stay as they are. Client payments go to the gym's Stripe account. You can suggest a price for the owner to approve, if your gym allows it. Trainers can invite clients to the gym, and invites they send show who sent them. Your own training lives under Settings › My Own Training. If the gym moves one of your clients to another trainer, their history goes with them and they're told in their chat. Can I see other trainers' clients? No. Only the owner, and managers, see everyone. What happens to my clients if I leave? They go back to the gym owner straight away.

s: Studio, Small Gym, Large Gym and Corporate: what each business plan includes.
b: Studio, Small Gym, Large Gym and Corporate: what each business plan includes. Studio: your team (up to 3 trainers), moving clients between trainers and your gym's branding. Small Gym adds the owner dashboard (Overview), the Manager role, a shared template library and CSV bulk invites of up to 100 rows. Large Gym adds trainer and client stats, QR check-in at the front desk and client retention. Corporate adds multi-site views: switch between locations and see totals across every verified location. Small Gym is £180 a month or £1,080 a year for up to 100 members. Large Gym is £260 a month or £1,560 a year for one gym with over 100 members. Corporate is £350 a month or £2,100 a year for the first location, plus £175 a month or £1,050 a year for each extra location. Ask us to set it up. Each plan includes everything on the plans before it. A feature your plan doesn't include shows which plan unlocks it, for example Available On Large Gym, so nothing is hidden. Each Corporate location is checked before it's added, with its own Stripe account. How does QR check-in work? On Large Gym, the front desk shows a code that clients scan to check in, once per client per day. What's in a CSV invite? A plain spreadsheet with a name and an email on each row.

s: Your list for today: your workout, your weekly check-in, and optional body stats and photos.
b: Your list for today: your workout, your weekly check-in, and optional body stats and photos. Open the Train tab. Things To Do Today is at the top. Each item shows To Do or Done, with a tick when it's done. Tap an item to do it: Today's Workout, Weekly Check-In, Body Stats or Progress Photos. Optional items are marked Optional. Tasks your coach sets for you show here too. Things To Do Today turns your coaching into a short list, so you never wonder what your coach expects from you. Under it, the week card lists this week's sessions in order, and you can hold and drag a session (or tap ⠿) to move it to another day. Do I have to do the optional items? No. They help your coach, but only the workout and check-in are expected. Why is my check-in not showing? It appears once a week, when it's due.

s: Start today's workout and tell the app how sore you are, so it can set your volume.
b: Start today's workout and tell the app how sore you are, so it can set your volume. Open the Train tab and tap Start Workout. How Sore Are You? asks about each muscle you've already trained this meso: Never Sore, Healed Early, Healed Just In Time or Still Sore. Answer each muscle, then tap Start Workout. Your exercises for the day open, with weights and reps to aim for. Up Next on Train shows the day, its RIR target, how many exercises and roughly how long it takes. Can't train today? Use Can't Train Today? Skip Or Move It before you tick any set. Your soreness answer is one of the signals Meso Gym uses to set this workout's sets. Healed early with work that felt manageable means room for more; still sore means fewer, so you recover and keep growing. Answer honestly: it's about the ache in the days after, not how tired you feel today. Why don't I get asked on my first workout? The question only covers muscles you've already trained this meso. Can I change the order of exercises? Yes. Tap Sort in the workout (see Sorting Exercises).

s: Log the weight and reps of every set. Meso Gym suggests what to lift next.
b: Log the weight and reps of every set. Meso Gym suggests what to lift next. In your workout, each exercise shows its sets with a suggested weight and reps in grey, the rep range and this week's RIR target. Do the set, type what you actually lifted, then tap the tick to log it. If you did exactly the grey numbers, just tick. The first weight you type fills in the other sets you haven't filled yet. Can't do a set? Tap its tick and choose Skip Set. ↺ brings it back. When every set is ticked or skipped, tap Finish & Give Feedback. Your target effort (RIR, reps in reserve) is shown for each week. Tap a set's number to make it a Myorep, Myorep Match or Drop Set. Once ticked, a small arrow compares the set with the same set last time: up, level or down. Tap it to see what you did then. The card also has + Set and − Set, Swap, Note (a reminder shown every time the exercise comes up) and History. From week two on, weights go up by themselves when you hit your reps. Does ticking a set start the rest timer? No. Press Start on the card when you want rest timed. What if I'm new to an exercise? The How To Choose Your Starting Weight bar walks you through a quick warm-up to find a working weight.

s: Can't train today? Skip the workout or move it to another day.
b: Can't train today? Skip the workout or move it to another day. Open the Train tab. Tap Can't Train Today? Skip Or Move It, before you tick any set. Train It Later Instead moves the day to the end of its week. Nothing else changes. Skip Session marks the day as skipped. Its muscles keep the same sets next week. This can't be undone. To put a session on a particular day, use Move To Another Day in the week list (see Moving A Day). Your coach sees it as skipped, not missed. Meso Gym runs a meso's sessions in order, not by date, so missing a day never breaks your plan. Days are labels: train Monday's session on Tuesday and the rest moves along. Skipping is for a session you won't do at all, and the muscles it would have trained simply hold their sets. Can I undo a skip? No. Skip Session can't be undone, so use Train It Later Instead if you might still do it. Will my coach be told? Yes. They see the day as skipped.

s: Swap an exercise for today, or ask your coach to change it for the rest of your meso.
b: Swap an exercise for today, or for the rest of your meso. If you have a coach, they can confirm lasting changes. In your workout, tap Swap on the exercise card. Pick another exercise for the same muscle. Best matches are listed first. Choose Today Only or All Future Workouts. Training on your own? Choose Today Only or All Future Workouts. If you have a coach, choose Today Only or Ask Coach For Rest Of Meso — a today swap applies straight away and your coach is told. Exercises graded D or F for growth are never offered by Swap. Your sets stay the same unless the new exercise is more demanding, in which case they may come down. The starting weight comes from the last time you did the new exercise; if you never have, start light. A swap is useful when equipment is busy or a movement doesn't suit your joints. What happens if my coach declines the rest-of-meso swap? Today's swap stays, and later weeks keep the original exercise. Can I swap back? Yes. Swap again and pick the original exercise.

s: Tell the app, and your coach, when a lift hurts a joint.
b: Tell the app when a lift hurts a joint. If you have a coach, they also see it. In your workout, use the Joint Pain tick box at the right of the exercise's reps line. Pick how bad it was: None, Mild, Moderate or Severe. The app adjusts next week for that exercise. If you have a coach, they get a pain report to review. Only use it if a joint (not a muscle) actually hurt. No pain? Leave it alone. Pain has its own icon and label, so it stands out. Mild changes nothing but is noted in History so you can spot a pattern. Moderate keeps next week's weight, reps and sets the same instead of progressing; Moderate or worse two weeks running suggests a swap. Severe drops one set, lowers the weight and offers a swap straight away. It only affects that exercise and is switched off in deload weeks. Should I keep training through pain? Pain that's sharp, swollen or lingers is worth getting checked by a professional. Does it change other exercises? No. Only the exercise you logged it on.

s: A few quick questions after each workout set next week's sets and weights.
b: A few quick questions after each workout set next week's sets and weights. Finish your workout: tap Finish & Give Feedback. How Did It Go? asks about each muscle you trained: Pump (Low, Medium, High) and Workload (Easy, Manageable, Hard, Too Much). Tap Save Session. Meso Gym uses your answers to set next week's sets. Session Saved shows each exercise with what's planned next week: more sets, fewer sets, or Hold Sets. Each question has a small ? that explains every answer. The last hard week and the deload ask no feedback. More sets come when you recovered early and the work felt easy or manageable. Sets stay the same when it felt hard or soreness only just cleared, and come down when you're still sore, it was too much, or your sets went backwards. Changes are small and gradual. Save without answering everything (Save Anyway) and those muscles simply repeat next week. What does May Change After Soreness Check mean? Your next How Sore Are You? answer can still change it. Can I edit a finished workout? No. A finished workout is locked; opening it shows a read-only Session Summary.

s: A rest timer between sets, and an interval timer you can turn on in Settings.
b: A rest timer between sets, with a time for each exercise. The interval timer is on by default. Turn it off in Settings › Interval Timer, or with the timer switch on a workout. On an exercise card, choose a rest time: 1:00, 1:30, 2:00 or 3:00. Tap Start on the card to start your rest. Ticking a set never starts it. While it runs, use −15s, +15s, Skip or Stop. Until you choose a time, the rest suits how demanding the exercise is (the dot marks it). Screen locked? It keeps counting, and in the phone app a notification tells you when rest is over. Resting long enough between hard sets lets you hit your reps at the target effort, which is what drives growth. Big lifts usually need longer rest than small isolation work, which is why each exercise keeps its own time. The first time a timer wants to notify you, Meso Gym explains why before your phone asks. Why didn't the timer start when I ticked a set? On purpose: press Start when you're ready to rest. Can I turn the notification off? Yes, in your phone's notification settings for Meso Gym.

s: Change the order of exercises in a workout.
b: Change the order of your exercises, for example when a machine is busy. In your workout, tap Sort at the top. It shows when the workout has more than one exercise. Sort Exercises lists each exercise, with its muscle and sets done. Drag ☰ to move an exercise, or use the up and down arrows. Tap Done to save, or Cancel to leave the order as it was. The new order is used for this day in later weeks too. Logged sets stay with their exercise. Sorting doesn't change your sets, weights or progression: it only changes the order. It works with a finger, a mouse or the keyboard arrow keys, and the page never scrolls under your drag. Finished workouts can't be sorted. Will sorting lose sets I've ticked? No. Ticked sets move with their exercise. Can I sort a finished workout? No. Sort only shows on a workout you haven't finished.

s: Add an exercise or remove one, today only or for the rest of the meso.
b: Add an extra exercise, or take one out, for today or for the rest of your meso. To add, tap + Add Exercise at the end of your workout and pick one. Choose Today Only or Rest Of Meso. To remove, tap the red bin on the exercise card. Choose Today Only or All Future Workouts, then confirm with Remove. A removed exercise isn't a skip: Today Only brings it back next week with its planned sets. The last exercise in a workout can't be removed. Use Skip / Move to miss the whole day. All Future Workouts takes the exercise off that day for the rest of the meso, so its muscle gets those sets fewer each week; your other exercises keep their plan. Sets you'd already ticked for it today are discarded. An added exercise starts from the last weight you logged for it. Workouts you've already finished are never changed. I have a coach. Why is there no bin? Your coach plans which exercises you do. Use Swap or − Set for today, or message your coach. Can I undo a removal? Add the exercise back with + Add Exercise.

s: Drag a session to another day, this week or every week.
b: Move a session to another day of the week, for this week or every week from now. On the Train tab, the This Week card lists your sessions. Hold and drag a session onto another to swap their days. Or tap ⠿ next to a session to open Move To Another Day. Pick a weekday, then This Week Only or Every Week From Now. Tap Swap With or Move To to confirm, or Cancel. Finished, skipped and started sessions stay where they are. Moving a day works on every plan, with or without a coach. Your sessions keep their order and progression; only the weekday changes. If the day you pick already has a session, the two swap places. Coaches see the same week list in their view of you, so they can move a day for you too. Can I move a session to a day that already has one? Yes. They swap days. Will it change my weights? No. Only the day changes.

s: Your coach builds your meso. It shows on your Train screen with their name.
b: Your coach builds your meso. It shows on your Train screen with their name. Open the Train tab. Your meso shows From your coach's business name. The Weeks grid shows what's done and what's next. Tap a locked day for a read-only preview. Tap Request Change to ask your coach to change something. Tap Mesos on your coach's page to see every meso they've sent you. Upcoming days show tags when your coach changed them, such as Swapped By Coach, Added By Coach, Removed By Coach or Coach Set. Your coach plans the meso; your logged sets and feedback still drive how it progresses week to week. When your coach changes a day, the change appears in your app after they send it, and workouts you've already finished never change. Can I swap an exercise myself? Yes, for today. For the rest of the meso, your coach decides. Why does a later week look different now? Later weeks are a forecast that your feedback, and your coach, shape.

s: Chat with your coach in the app.
b: Chat with your coach in the app. Open the Coach tab, or tap Open Chat on the Train screen. Tap Messages. Type your message and tap Send. With the box empty, tap the microphone to record a voice note. A number on the Coach tab means a new reply. Ticks show ✓ sent and ✓✓ delivered. Your coach's small photo appears under the last message they've seen. Messages keep everything about your coaching in one place: replies to your check-ins and form checks land here too. Tap your coach's photo to see it larger, with their specialisms underneath. Your coach's replies to your check-ins and form checks land in the same chat, so the whole conversation stays together. Each chat is private between you and your coach, and you can scroll back through everything you've sent, including voice notes and form check replies. Will I get a notification? Yes, if you turn on notifications. Meso Gym explains why before your phone asks. Can other clients see my chat? No. It's just you and your coach.

s: Send your coach a short video of a lift for feedback.
b: Send your coach a short video of a lift for feedback. Open the Coach tab and tap Form Checks. Tap Send A Form Check and record or choose a video. Add a note, for example what felt off, and send. Your coach's reply appears in Messages, linked to the video. Film from the side at hip height, and include the whole movement. A form check gives your coach a clear look at a lift without needing to be in the gym together. Because their reply is linked to the video, you can rewatch it next to their notes before your next session. Good light and a steady phone make a big difference. Film the set you want feedback on at your normal working weight, rather than a warm-up, so your coach sees how the lift really moves under load. How long should the video be? One or two reps is usually enough. Who can see my videos? Only you and your coach.

s: Join a video call with your coach from the app.
b: Join a video call with your coach from the app. When your coach calls, you get a notification. Tap it to join. You can also start a call from the Coach tab: tap Video Call. Allow your camera and microphone the first time. When you're done, end the call. A line in your chat shows how it went, such as Video Call · 4 min or Missed Call. Prop your phone up so your coach can see the whole lift during a form review. Calls run inside Meso Gym, so there's no meeting link or phone number to swap. They're handy for a quick catch-up, going through a new meso together, or a live look at your technique. I missed a call. Your chat shows Missed Call. Message your coach or call back from the Coach tab. Does it work on the web? Yes, in the web app as well as on iPhone and Android.

s: Pay your coach by card in the app, and see what you've paid.
b: Pay your coach by card in the app, and see what you've paid. Open the Coach tab and tap Payments. Coaching Payments shows your tier, your price and when the next payment is due. When your coach requests a payment, tap Pay and check out securely with Stripe. Agree to your coach's terms the first time you pay. Your money goes to your coach's own Stripe account. Receipts for coaching come from your coach's Stripe account. Payments are taken by Stripe, so your card details never go to Meso Gym or your coach. If your coach refunds you, you get an email from them with the amount and what happens to your coaching; banks usually take 5–10 days. How do I stop paying? Talk to your coach. They can stop future payments for you. My payment failed. Check your card details and try again; your coach is told so they can help.

s: Tell your coach about your health, training experience, goals and week.
b: Tell your coach about your health, training experience, goals and week. Open the Coach tab and tap About You (or Settings › Open Health Info). Step 1: Health Info asks about health conditions and injuries. Step 2: Your Training covers your goal, experience, current split, muscles to focus on, equipment, days a week and session length. Tap Save. Your coach sees it on your client page. You can withdraw consent to share health info at any time. Your answers are used straight away: when your coach builds a meso for you, the builder starts from your days, session length, experience, equipment, goal, priority muscles and current split. Update it whenever something changes, such as a new injury, a different gym or more days a week, so your coach plans around the real you. Can my coach change my answers? No. Only you can add or change them. Do I have to answer the health questions? No, but they help your coach keep you safe.

t: Changes When You Have A Coach
s: Today Only, or ask your coach for the rest of the meso.
b: Your coach plans your meso, but you can still adjust today's workout. In your workout, tap + Set, − Set or Swap on an exercise. Choose Today Only to change just this workout. Or choose Ask Coach For Rest Of Meso to send your coach a request. A swap for today applies straight away, and your coach is told. If your coach approves a swap, your later days show Your Swap · Approved. This keeps you in control on the gym floor while your coach keeps the plan. Today Only changes never carry into later weeks. When your coach changes your meso, upcoming days show tags like Coach Set, Swapped By Coach, Added By Coach or Removed By Coach, so you always know what's new. What if my coach says no? Your change for today stays, and later weeks keep the original plan. Does a Today Only change affect my progress? Your logged sets still count as normal.

s: Log how your week went: scores, answers and optional photos. If you have a coach, they see it too.
b: Log how your week went: scores, answers and optional photos. If you have a coach, they see it too. On the Train tab, tap Weekly Check-In under Things To Do Today. Enter your Body Weight in your own unit (kg or lb). Score each question from 1 to 5 and answer any written questions. Tap Send Check-In. Check-In Sent offers Back To Training, View Past Check-Ins and Add Progress Photos. Past Check-Ins lists the weeks you've already sent, newest first. Use the check-in as your own weekly review. If you have a coach, they read it next to your training, so honest answers help them decide whether to push on or ease off. The questions may be your coach's own, and they may change from time to time. Try to send it on the same day each week, so your coach can compare like with like. If you have something to add that doesn't fit the questions, send it in Messages. I missed a week. Send it when you can. If you have a coach, they see No Check-In Last Week until then. Does my coach see my body weight in kg? If you have a coach, they see it in the unit you used.

s: Take front, side and back photos to see your change over time.
b: Take front, side and back photos to see your change over time. Open Progress › Body, then Progress Photos (or the Photos tab). Tap Add Photo. The first time, Meso Gym explains why before your phone asks for camera and photo access. Take a photo for each pose, or Choose From Gallery. Flip switches camera. Compare Start vs Latest, or tap a photo to see it full screen or delete it. A photo every two weeks is plenty: the next one is due 14 days after your last. Training on your own? Photos stay on this phone. Coached? Only you and your coach can see them. Photos show the change over a meso that the mirror misses. They're compressed to save space. Photos kept on your phone are never uploaded and aren't in the backup file. I tapped Not Now on the explainer. That's fine: it shows again next time you add a photo. Photo access is off. Open your phone's Settings (or browser site settings) and allow camera and photos for Meso Gym.

s: Log your weight and measurements and see the trend.
b: Log your weight and measurements and see the trend. Open Progress › Body. Choose Centimetres or Inches. Enter your weight and measurements such as waist, then tap Save. Switch between Weight and Waist to see each chart. Weigh in at the same time of day, ideally in the morning, for a fair trend. Body weight moves around day to day, so look at the trend over weeks rather than any single reading. Coached clients share their body stats with their coach, who sees them with each weekly check-in. Waist and other measurements are a useful second view alongside weight: during a building phase your weight may rise while your waist stays steady, which is often a sign the extra weight is muscle. Log measurements every week or two under the same conditions, for example first thing in the morning. Can I use kg and inches? Yes. Weight follows your weight unit and measurements use the unit you pick here. Is it required? No. Body Stats is optional on Things To Do Today.

s: Strength per exercise, weekly sets per muscle, your Body Map and Power Level.
b: Strength per exercise, weekly sets per muscle, your Body Map and Power Level. Open the Progress tab. The Body Map shows which muscles you've trained. Tap a muscle to see what you've logged for it. Power Level shows how much of this meso's planned hard sets you've completed. Sessions per Exercise and Weekly Sets per Muscle show your sessions and planned against completed sets. Strength per Exercise plots your estimated 1RM and top-set weight. Tap Change to pick another exercise. Your Badge Shelf is on Progress too (see Badge Shelf). Estimated 1RM is worked out from the weight and reps of your best set, so sets with different reps can be compared. Power Level starts empty and is full at your last hard week if you do every planned set; extra sets, skipped sessions and the deload don't count. A faint marker shows your last meso's peak. Why is my strength chart in kg? It uses your active meso's unit and converts the rest. Coached clients Progress shows Strength, Body and Check-Ins, and your coach sees your strength too.

s: Badges for real training milestones, with what earned each one.
b: Badges for real training milestones, earned from what you've actually logged. Open the Progress tab. Your Badge Shelf shows how many you've earned, newest first. Tap a badge to see when it was earned and what earned it, and to Share it. Up Next shows the badges you're closest to, with progress bars. Tap See All to see every badge in its group. New badges show as Badge Earned when you finish a workout. Your very first workout gets its own Your 1st Workout! screen. Meso Summary has a Meso Badges card for the badges that meso earned. Badges come in six groups: Getting Started, Consistency, Mesocycles, Strength And PBs, Body And Check-Ins, and Coach. Examples are First Workout, Full Week, On Track (90% or more of a meso's planned sessions), Comeback (training again after 14 days or more off), Meso Complete, Took The Deload, New PB, PB Week (3 or more PBs in a week) and Progress Pics (photos in 3 different months). Some, like Full Week and Meso Complete, level up from Steel to Silver, Sky and Chrome. Training on your own, there are 12 badges; coached, there are 15, adding Set Up Right, Check-In Regular and Feedback Given. I've trained for months. Do I start from zero? No. Badges are filled in from your past training, with the real dates. Can I lose a badge? No. Once earned, a badge stays earned. Can my coach see my badges? Yes. Your coach sees your latest badges and your full shelf, and New PBs and Meso Complete show in their Group Wins.

s: Training on your own? Build a hypertrophy meso in a few steps.
b: Training on your own? Build a hypertrophy meso in a few steps. Open the Plan tab and tap Create Mesocycle (or Create Your First Mesocycle on Train). Step One: name it, then choose your working weeks and your experience: Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. Step Two: choose Build It For Me, Starter Splits or Build My Own, or start from a previous meso. Step Three: check it in the Routine Builder and tap Create Mesocycle. A deload week is added at the end. Not sure about experience? Choose Beginner: it sets how many sets week one starts with. Build It For Me asks four questions (days a week, equipment, experience and muscles to focus on) and fills each day for you. In the builder, Shuffle swaps in different exercises and pin keeps the ones you like. The Weekly Sets per Muscle table shows week one; if a muscle is short, Fix tops it up. Is my draft saved? Yes. An unfinished draft waits until you Create or Discard it. Can I train on set weekdays? Yes. Pick the weekdays you train in the builder.

s: See your current meso day by day, its weekly sets per muscle and every past meso.
b: See your current meso day by day, its weekly sets per muscle and every past meso. Open the Plan tab. Your active meso shows each day and its exercises, plus weekly sets per muscle, done and planned. Use Make Active, End Meso Early or Start Next Meso From This. Past Mesocycles lists finished mesos. Tap one to see its summary, or Use as Template to start a new meso from it. Delete History Only removes a past meso's logged workouts but keeps its plan as a template. Past mesos are kept as read-only records of every session and your feedback, so you can see how a block went before planning the next one. Delete Mesocycle, at the top of Plan, removes a meso or template for good. Can I run two mesos at once? Only one is active; Make Active switches between them. Does ending early lose my workouts? No. End Meso Early keeps everything you've logged.

s: The last week is a lighter deload. Then you see your meso summary and start the next one.
b: The last week is a lighter deload. Then you see your meso summary and start the next one. In the deload week, sets, reps and weights drop so you recover, getting lighter again late in the week (marked ½). When the last workout is done, Train shows Mesocycle Complete. View Meso Summary shows your strength gains, personal bests, volume and Meso Badges. Tap Plan Next Meso, or wait for your coach to send one. The deload and the last hard week ask no feedback, and the deload doesn't count towards Power Level. Recovery is when you grow, which is why the deload is built in. Skip Deload And Finish Meso ends the meso without it if you really want to go straight into a new block. Your next meso starts from where you began last time, nudged up by the progress you made, not from the heavy weights at the end. Why does the deload feel so easy? That's the point: it lets fatigue clear so you start the next meso fresh. Do I get a badge for the deload? Yes. Took The Deload is earned when you finish it as planned.

s: One plan for up to 5 people: you plus 4 invited by code. Everyone trains on their own account.
b: One plan for up to 5 people: you plus 4 invited by code. Everyone trains on their own account. Open Account › Family. Tap New Invite Code to make a code for each person. They sign in on their own phone and enter it under I Have An Invite Code. Remove a member any time to free their place. Each code works once and must be used within 7 days. Family members can message and video call each other (see Family Chat And Video Calls). Everyone signs in on their own device, and each person's training stays in their own account, so the plan is shared but the workouts are not. You can see who has joined and which codes are still waiting on the Family page. Does leaving a coach take me off the Family plan? No. Your coach link and your Family membership are separate. How many codes can I make? One for each free place: up to 4 people as well as you.

s: Theme, units, timer, tips, custom exercises, volume landmarks and backups.
b: Theme, units, timer, tips, custom exercises, volume landmarks and backups. Open the Settings tab. Choose your theme (Dark or Light) and default unit (kg or lb). Turn the Interval Timer on or off, and replay the intro or reset tips. Add custom exercises and set your volume landmarks. Under Backup, tap Export Meso Gym to save a backup file, or Import Meso Gym to restore one. Each meso keeps its own unit. Import From RP brings mesos and logged sets across from an RP Hypertrophy app export. Volume Landmarks are the weekly set targets for each muscle, from Maintain to Max. Changes apply to mesos you create from now on, and Reset To Defaults puts the research-based values back. Signed in, your training syncs to your account; backups are an extra copy you control. Who can export? Anyone, including during the 7-day Pro trial. Importing needs a paid Pro plan or Family membership. Are photos in the backup? No. Progress photos stay on your phone.

s: Your profile photo, notifications, Pro access and account details. Leave a coach if you have one.
b: Your profile photo, notifications, Pro access and account details. Open the Account tab. Upload a profile photo and choose your notifications. Pro Access shows where your Pro comes from (your own plan, Family, or a coach). Under Your Account, change your username, password or email. If you have a coach, Leave Coach stops coaching; your training history stays with you. Download My Data gives you one file with your account, training, and any coaching or payments on this account. Open Payments & Receipts for your plan payment history. If you leave a coach, sharing stops, the shared copy is deleted and access through their plan ends. Your own mesos and workouts stay on your phone, and any Family plan or subscription of your own carries on. Delete Account removes your synced data and cancels a website subscription, but not a store subscription. Will I keep Pro after leaving a coach? Access through your coach's plan ends. A Family plan or your own subscription carries on. Can I rejoin a coach later? Yes, with a new invite or your coach's join link.

s: Why Meso Gym asks for a permission, and only when you need it.
b: Meso Gym only asks for a permission when you need it, and explains why first. Tap something that needs a permission, for example Add Photo or turning on notifications. A short explainer says why, for example Add Progress Photos or Turn On Notifications. Tap Allow Photos (or Turn On Notifications) and your phone asks for permission. Or tap Not Now. The explainer shows again next time. You're never asked on first launch. If you've already allowed it, there's no explainer. Progress photos are private. Coached, only you and your coach can see them; training on your own, they stay on this phone. If you've turned a permission off, the explainer tells you how to turn it on in your phone's Settings. Allowing is remembered for each person and each permission. I tapped Don't Allow by mistake. Open your phone's Settings, find Meso Gym and turn the permission on. Do I need notifications? No, but they tell you about coach messages and when rest is over.

t: Change Email And Download Your Data
s: Change your sign-in email safely and download a copy of your data.
b: Change the email you sign in with, or download a copy of your data. Open Account › Your Account (coaches: Account › Sign-In And Email) and tap Change Email. Enter your New Email and Current Password, then tap Send Link. Open the link in the email to your new address within 24 hours, on any device. You'll see Email Changed. To get your data, tap Download My Data. Until you open the link, keep signing in with your old email. Your old address gets a notice. Download My Data is free for everyone, Pro or not. The download is one file with your account, training, and any coaching or payments on this account. Change Email is for email-and-password accounts; if you sign in with Google or Apple, use Switch To Email Sign-In first. If the link has run out you'll see Link Expired, and an address already in use shows Email Already Used. The link expired. Start again from Change Email to get a new link. Does changing email affect my training? No. Everything stays in your account.

s: Pick a username and sign in with it instead of your email.
b: Pick a username and sign in with it instead of your email. Open Settings › Account (coaches: the Account tab) and find your username. Tap Choose A Username, or Change. Type 3 to 20 characters: letters, numbers and underscores only. Tap Save Username. On Sign In and Forgot Password, type your Email or Username. You can change your username once every 30 days. If you were given a username automatically, your first change is free. A username is quicker to type on a phone than a long email address. Your email still works for signing in. Usernames are checked as you type, so you'll know straight away whether one is free and allowed. Once saved, your username shows in your account details, and you can sign in with either it or your email on any device. My username is taken. Try another: each username is unique. Can I use spaces or full stops? No. Letters, numbers and underscores only.

s: Message and video call the people on your Family plan.
b: Message and video call the people on your Family plan. Open Account › Family. The Family Chat card lists everyone on your plan, as Family Organiser or Family Member. Tap a person to message them, or start a video call. A badge on the Account tab shows new family messages. When someone joins your Family plan, you can message and video call them here. Family Chat keeps training talk in the app where your workouts are, so you can plan sessions together or cheer on a PB. Each chat is between two people, and everyone's training still stays in their own account. Video calls ring the other person's app wherever they are in Meso Gym, so they can answer straight away. A chat appears for each person as soon as they've joined with an invite code, and the list shows who's the Family Organiser and who's a Family Member. Who can I message? Only the people on your Family plan. Can my coach see family chats? No. Family chats are separate from your coach chat.

s: Your Meso Gym plan payments and store purchases in one list. Coach payments only if you have a coach.
b: Your payments and receipts in one place. Open Account › Payments & Receipts. Each row shows the date, plan name and amount. For a website plan, tap Download Receipt to open the Stripe invoice. For an App Store or Google Play purchase, tap Open App Store or Open Google Play to manage it there. If you have a coach, a Payments To Your Coach section lists those payments too. Family members on someone else's Family plan see a note that the organiser holds the receipts. You still get a website-plan receipt email when a payment goes through. Website Individual, Family and trainer plans are billed by Meso Gym through Stripe, so Download Receipt opens that invoice. Store purchases are billed by Apple or Google, so Meso Gym cannot show a PDF for those — use the store link instead. Coaching payments only appear when you are coached; their receipts come from your coach's Stripe account (see Paying Your Coach). Each row on Payments & Receipts lists what you paid for and when, so it's easy to match against your bank statement. Website plans also email a receipt each time a payment goes through. I didn't get a website receipt email. Check spam, then send a message from the Contact page at mesogym.com/contact.html. Where are coaching receipts? Only if you have a coach: in Payments To Your Coach, and in the receipt email from your coach's Stripe. See Paying Your Coach.
